basics.name: Naufal Hakim Syahputra
basics.headline: Senior Backend Engineer | AI Systems & Reliable Integrations

summary.name: Summary
summary.content: I build Go and Python services, data integrations, and AI-assisted workflows. My work spans commerce, recruitment, payments, and media—from Laravel-to-Go migration to resilient asynchronous processing.

items.summary: Built an AI listing-video agent, a self-service video workflow, and customer and internal ordering experiences.
summaries: Built an OpenClaw-based AI agent that turns 3–8 property photos into 10–30-second listing videos, with staff approval before paid rendering.
Improved AI workflow recovery with persisted job state, controlled provider concurrency, and retries for failed outputs; built a FastAPI worker and FFmpeg assembly for self-service video generation.
Delivered an internal order-management MVP with Next.js and NestJS and developed a checkout hand-off with server-owned payment verification.

items.summary: Built a candidate data platform and a pre-production lead management platform for recruitment operations.
summaries: Built a candidate data platform with React, Go, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, and Python, centralizing approximately 3,000 profiles for résumé intake and recruiter search.
Developed asynchronous résumé-processing workflows with Go, Python, and Kafka, and contributed schema handling to the team’s PostgreSQL-to-Elasticsearch outbox synchronization.
Built a pre-production lead management platform with SvelteKit, Go, and MySQL, including a backend read model combining company, contact, job, and outreach data for search and reporting.

multipleSummaries.company: PT Tri Cipta Integra | Dec 2023 – Oct 2026
summaries: Built and improved omnichannel support and CRM workflows for multiple clients, including chat distribution, messaging, history handling, and AI-assisted knowledge and recording analysis.
Built Go services to synchronize SAP inventory across warehouses, adding scheduled synchronization, NiFi retries, and delivery-order reconciliation.
Built Laravel and PostgreSQL inventory reporting and reconciliation workflows; integrated Shopee APIs with idempotent synchronization to reduce duplicate processing and overselling risk.

items.summary: Built Go services for the One-Stop Tool, Home Trend, and RFQ and payment platforms serving Renos.id’s Indonesian and Thai markets.
summaries: Design & Build: Built Go services for a shared Indonesia–Thailand back-office platform, supporting survey, vendor, quotation, VAT, and payment workflows with NetSuite integration.
Built Go services for HomeTrend discovery and B2B bidding, including quotation and checkout workflows.

items.summary: Decomposed a Laravel monolith into independently deployable Go microservices, built third-party integrations, and implemented Elasticsearch-backed product search.
summaries: Decomposed a Laravel monolith into independently deployable Go microservices, redesigning service boundaries and introducing concurrent processing.
Built third-party integrations for ERP, marketing, logistics, and payments, and implemented Elasticsearch-backed product search.
Integrated SonarCloud and Sentry into delivery workflows while collaborating with frontend, QA, DevOps, and analytics teams.

items.summary: Built Laravel backend services and REST APIs for marketplace, agricultural, legal-service, and HR platforms.
summaries: Built Laravel backend services and REST APIs for marketplace, agricultural, and legal-service platforms, covering commerce workflows, relational data modeling, role-based access, and transactional operations.
Delivered a Dockerized HRIS using Laravel, PostgreSQL, and Redis caching to support concurrent employee and organizational workflows.

items.title: Regional Back-Office Services
items.description: Built Go services for survey, vendor, quotation, VAT, and payment workflows, with NetSuite integration for Indonesian and Thai operations.

caseStudy.challenge: Support regional operations from survey and quotation through vendor, payment, and ERP-related workflows across Indonesian and Thai markets.
caseStudy.ownership: Built Go services for the shared back-office platform.
approach: Supported survey, vendor, quotation, VAT, and payment workflows.
Integrated with NetSuite.
impact: Supported a shared Indonesia–Thailand back-office platform.

items.title: AI-Assisted Candidate Platform
items.description: Built candidate intake and recruiter search with Go, PostgreSQL, Elasticsearch, Python, and Kafka, including AI-assisted résumé processing.

caseStudy.challenge: Centralize résumé intake and recruiter search while coordinating AI processing and updates to the search index.
caseStudy.ownership: Built candidate platform and AI-assisted résumé-processing workflows; contributed schema handling to the team’s search synchronization.
approach: Developed asynchronous résumé-processing requests using Go, Python, and Kafka, including CV parsing and consumer concurrency controls.
Added schema context to events in the team’s transactional outbox for PostgreSQL-to-Elasticsearch synchronization, which includes retries and dead-letter handling.
impact: Centralized approximately 3,000 candidate profiles for résumé intake and recruiter search.

items.title: AI Listing Video Workflow
items.description: Built an internal OpenClaw listing-video agent with staff approval before paid rendering, persisted job state, and recovery for failed outputs.

caseStudy.challenge: Turn property photos into listing videos while retaining staff review before paid rendering and supporting recovery from failed outputs.
caseStudy.ownership: Built the OpenClaw-based listing-video agent and worked on approval, provider monitoring, and workflow recovery.
approach: Added staff approval before paid rendering and persisted job state across workflow stages.
Limited concurrent provider requests and distinguished status monitoring from submitting paid generation.
Retried failed outputs while preserving completed clips.
impact: Supported 3–8 property photos and 10–30-second listing videos.

items.title: Customer Ordering Platform
items.description: Built a customer ordering MVP with accounts, private uploads, order tracking, invoices, and checkout.

caseStudy.challenge: Provide a customer ordering experience for listing content.
caseStudy.ownership: Built the public website and customer ordering MVP.
approach: Used Next.js, React, TypeScript, and Supabase for customer workflows.
Developed a checkout hand-off with server-owned payment verification.
Hardened payment creation with scoped idempotency keys and reused eligible active payment attempts; routed mismatched payment responses for review during reconciliation.

items.title: Auto AI Video Self-Service Builder
items.description: Built a FastAPI worker and FFmpeg assembly for a customer-facing self-service video workflow, with persisted processing state and controlled provider requests.

caseStudy.challenge: Support customer-initiated, long-running video generation with recovery for failed outputs.
caseStudy.ownership: Built a FastAPI worker and FFmpeg assembly for self-service video generation.
approach: Persisted processing state, controlled provider concurrency, and retried failed outputs.
Used FFmpeg to assemble generated video for delivery.

items.title: Lead Pool and Lead Tracking
items.description: Built a pre-production lead platform with Go, MySQL, and SvelteKit, including a backend read model and scraper batch import.

caseStudy.challenge: Bring company, contact, job, and outreach data together for search and reporting.
caseStudy.ownership: Built a pre-production lead management platform.
approach: Built a backend read model and projector combining company, contact, job-posting, and outreach data for search and reporting.
Added a scraper batch-import workflow and tests for imported lead data.
impact: Supported search and reporting in a pre-production platform.

items.title: SAP Inventory Synchronization
items.description: Built Go services for SAP inventory synchronization across warehouses, scheduled updates, NiFi retries, and delivery-order reconciliation.

caseStudy.challenge: Synchronize SAP inventory across warehouses and support delivery-order reconciliation.
caseStudy.ownership: Built Go services for SAP inventory synchronization and worked on delivery-order reconciliation.
approach: Added scheduled SAP stock synchronization and NiFi retries for network errors and server failures.
Worked on delivery-order reconciliation to support inventory and order-state alignment.
impact: Supported inventory synchronization across warehouses and delivery-order reconciliation.

items.title: Renos HomeTrend Platform
items.description: Built Go and PostgreSQL services for home-design discovery, curated content, saved collections, and role-based publishing.

caseStudy.challenge: Support home-design inspiration and product discovery through curated content and saved collections.
approach: Supported curated content, product discovery, saved collections, and role-based publishing.

items.title: B2B Bidding and Checkout
items.description: Developed Go services for B2B quotation and checkout workflows, including promotion validation, access checks, and secure file uploads.

caseStudy.challenge: Support structured bulk-procurement requests and quotations between buyers and sellers, with a checkout workflow.
caseStudy.ownership: Developed backend bidding and checkout services.
approach: Implemented quotation workflows, promotion validation, access checks, and secure file uploads.
impact: Supported B2B quotation and checkout workflows.

items.title: Omnichannel Helpdesk and CRM
items.description: Built and improved omnichannel support and CRM workflows for Integra clients, including chat distribution, messaging, history handling, and AI-assisted analysis.

caseStudy.challenge: Support client-specific customer-service workflows across messaging, ticketing, and CRM systems.
caseStudy.ownership: Built and improved omnichannel messaging, ticketing, chat distribution, and AI-assisted support workflows across multiple client projects.
approach: Improved chat distribution, messaging, webchat, history handling, and operational reliability across customer-service implementations.
Integrated AI-assisted knowledge and recording or text analysis, including API clients, error handling, feedback, and batch-processing workflows.
impact: Supported customer-service workflows across multiple client implementations.

items.title: Inventory Reporting and Synchronization
items.description: Built Laravel and PostgreSQL inventory reporting and reconciliation workflows for a multichannel commerce product, including idempotent Shopee API synchronization.

caseStudy.challenge: Support inventory reporting across warehouse and marketplace workflows while reducing the risk of duplicate processing and overselling.
caseStudy.ownership: Built inventory reporting and reconciliation workflows.
approach: Integrated Shopee APIs with idempotent synchronization.
impact: Addressed duplicate processing and overselling risk.
